mapper.select: select c.*, u.username, u.avatar from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.weibo_id = #{weiboId} order by c.create_time
mapper.insert: insert into comment(weibo_id, user_id, content, parent_id, reply_to) values(#{weiboId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyTo})
mapper.update: update comment set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{id}
update comment set like_count = like_count - 1 where id = #{id}
